tasks.title: Harden the autonomous control layer
tasks.description: Strengthen CLAUDE.md with hard rules, improve scripts with strict mode and clear failure semantics, rewrite run-automation.sh as a real task orchestrator
success_criteria: CLAUDE.md updated with hard rules
All scripts use set -euo pipefail strict mode
Scripts have clear failure semantics and no fake success states
check-db.sh only does health checks, no full imports
check-api.sh only checks running status, no forced startup
run-automation.sh rewritten as task orchestrator with list/next/start/complete/check commands
Comprehensive report created
task.json and progress.md updated

tasks.title: Integrate Claude Code executor into the control layer
tasks.description: Turn the current task orchestrator into a real single-task execution launcher for Claude Code
success_criteria: run-automation.sh supports list/next/check
New command invokes Claude Code for exactly one selected task
Generated prompt instructs Claude to read required files and execute one task
One-task-per-run semantics kept
No business features implemented in this task
Limitations documented clearly
task.json and progress.md updated
Report created

tasks.title: Enforce dependency-aware task execution in the orchestrator
tasks.description: Make the orchestrator choose the correct next task and refuse execution when dependencies are not satisfied
success_criteria: get_next_task must prefer ready high-priority tasks over medium-priority tasks
start/execute must check task dependencies before changing status
if dependencies are unmet, print the missing task IDs and exit with a clear non-zero code
do not modify business logic
update task.json and progress.md
create .ai/reports/dependency_aware_orchestration.md

tasks.title: Fix strict priority selection in orchestrator
tasks.description: Fix get_next_task() to prioritize high priority strictly, and update header text
success_criteria: get_next_task() collects all ready high-priority tasks first
get_next_task() takes first ready high if any, only then looks at medium
update header text to reflect that execute calls Claude Code
update task.json and progress.md
create report documenting the fix
